description: Get the US spot crypto ETFs that have started trading, for one asset or all 16: ticker, name, issuer, exchange, listing date, sponsor fee (percent per year), current net assets (`netAssetsUsdM`, USD millions) and coins held, plus the total net assets of each asset. Net assets are a current snapshot, not a history. `netAssetsBasis` is reported (published by the issuer for `netAssetsDate`), repriced (the latest published figure moved to that day by the NAV change of other funds) or estimated (coins times price, for issuers without daily holdings). `coinsHeld` is null for issuers that do not publish holdings in coins. Each fund also has `effectiveFeePct` and `feeWaiver` (a fee waiver in effect today), `feeRevenueUsdMPerYear` (net assets times the fee charged today, USD millions), `supplySharePct` (its coins as a share of circulating supply), `staking` (status from SEC filings, share staked, net yield and how rewards are paid) and `delistedAt` for a closed fund.

asset.description: Optional asset filter: btc, eth, sol, xrp, hyp, doge, link, avax, hbar, ltc, bnb, dot, sui, near, trx, zec
